test_title: PYST 1: SSC Stenographer - English (Held On:12 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: english
question:
Select the option that changes the form of narration in the following sentence.

My sister asked me, “When will I be allowed to go to the church?”

options.text: My sister asked me that when she would be allowed to go to the church.
My sister prayed when she will be allowed to go to the church.
My sister asked me when she would be allowed to go to the church.
My sister asked me when she will be allowed to go to the church.

solution:
The correct answer is: **'My sister asked me when she would be allowed to go to the church'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The appropriate answer of the narration is: **'My sister asked me when she would be allowed to go to the church'.**
 
• According to the rule of Narration, the reported speech will be in past form if the reporting verb is in past tense.
 
• So, '**asked'** is in '**past tense'**, the reported speech will also be in** 'past form of the verb'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **'Option 3'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **'My sister asked me that when she would be allowed to go to the church'** is not correct here.
 
• **'My sister prayed when she will be allowed to go to the church' **is not correct here.
 
• **'My sister asked me when she will be allowed to go to the church'** is not correct here.
